goal: Supplemental, post-hoc replacement for the original cohort's Codecraft project, which failed before any Jev call because it lacked canonical MSSR initialization.

plan.independentUnit: one distinct project repository; its positive and negative query form one cluster, not two independent samples
plan.primaryMetric: Source-scoped search candidate coverage and live Jev select/abstain disposition; exact fetched range/evidence-pack integrity.
secondaryMetrics: target range presence in top-k search
selected range line overlap and overbreadth
raw Choice confidence as uncalibrated descriptive output
plan.uncertaintyMethod: descriptive counts only; this packet contributes one independent project cluster and cannot support reliability or calibration claims
plan.metadataScope: metadataMode=off; one explicit sourceRef per case; no atom metadata, query variants, contradiction review, or automatic source discovery
plan.emptyPoolRule: if search returns no handles, record no-candidate and do not call Jev; this is not a correct abstention

corpus.sourceRevision: Exact source SHA-256, repository HEAD/branch, target-file cleanliness, and frozen snapshot recorded.
corpus.holdoutStatus: No matching local run-ledger exposure found; not a certified holdout and public-document exposure cannot be ruled out.
corpus.labelSource: two independent blind source-only Luna reviews

labels.source: two independent blind source-only Luna reviews
labels.adjudication: Reviewers independently read the exact frozen README and queries before any live call; labels are file-scoped, not repository-owner gold.

provider.provider: TypeSafe Jev through frozen Bridge 0.6.175 release-module provider adapter
provider.credentialSource: Windows Credential Manager; secret value not persisted
provider.networkOptInMethod: explicit command-line --allow-network plus user authorization recorded in manifest

source.providerAdapter: createMssrJevBridgeDecisionProvider and createMssrSemanticEvidenceToolModule from frozen Bridge release build

projectContextPreflight.purpose: Experiment-specific required gate: Librarian needs canonical project initialization even with metadata mode off.
